lane_formation.description: Agents spontaneously organize into opposite directional lanes in narrow corridors to minimize head-on collisions.

turn_taking.description: Agents pause or yield at corridor entrances when an oncoming agent is detected inside the bottleneck.

role_specialisation.description: Agents divide labor: specific agents specialize as primary haulers while others clear bottlenecks or manage charging.

convoy_behavior.description: Agents form single-file platoons following identical trajectories to move efficiently through high-density zones.
